root_cause: A governance-only merged commit was incorrectly interpreted as a stale website deployment when the source classifier intentionally allows no Netlify runtime rebuild.
prevention: Classify deployment applicability independently from provider commit equality; never call a skipped build a production failure or matching SHA complete runtime verification.

evidence.tests: Four regression tests committed to candidate; native Required and CodeQL must confirm
evidence.production_readback: NOT_REQUIRED_FOR_GOVERNANCE_CHANGE; no new production deploy asserted

regression_contract: Required and CodeQL must pass on exact head; provider SHA+runtime readback is mandatory for changed website/runtime artifact.
